reason: Nice policies, but I've never heard of them and I can't tell from photos whether a paper pendant looks cheap in person. I'd save it to a board and wait to see if anyone real has bought and posted it.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and a new store with almost no reviews gives me nothing else to go on. Free returns help, but I don't want to hang a fixture and then repack it in a rental unit.
would_change_my_mind: Real customer photos of installed pieces, close-up video showing the material and finish, or a cheap fabric or material sample I could hold before ordering.
